_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: S1000D Data Management Requirement List
summary: Specifies the format and content requirements for the S1000D Data Management Requirement List used to initiate Data Module templates in the Navy's Common Source Database.
use_relationship:
The S1000D Data Management Requirement List shall be used to initiate Data Module templates in the Navy's Common Source Database.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to all new contracts and solicitations that acquire S1000D Issues 4.0 and newer based technical documentation.

The DID may also be applicable to technical documentation already in production for major changes and upgrades.

S1000D, referenced in this Data Item Description, can be obtained at www.s1000d.org.

references.label: NAVSEA S1000D Tagging and Authoring Guide

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of any documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Data Management Requirement List shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figure 1 and shall contain the following columns of information.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The content of the columns identified below shall follow the requirements of S1000D. All columns listed below are mandatory. The Learn Code (LCN) and Learn Event Code (LEC) columns are populated when applicable; population of all other columns of information is always mandatory. The columns shall contain the Standard Numbering System breakdown as specified in S1000D. The Data Management Requirement List shall contain all the appropriate Data Modules required to generate the applicable technical documentation.

children.title: Title DMC Column
children.content: The text "DMC" shall be entered in the Title DMC column.

children.title: Master Naming scheme (MNS) Column
children.content: The Master Naming Scheme shall be specific to NAVSEA's Common Source Database and shall contain Model Identification Code and shall identify the project to which the data applies.

children.title: Model Identification Code (MI) Column
children.content: The Model Identification Code (MI) identifies the project to which the data applies and shall be the point of reference for all applicability information. The model identification code shall include all related model variants.

children.title: System Difference Code (SDC) Column
children.content: The System Difference Code (SDC) indicates alternative versions of the system and subsystem/sub-subsystem identified by the Standard Numbering System without affecting the type, model or variant identity.

children.title: System Code (SC) Column
children.content: The System Code (SC) is comprised of the material item category code and a code representing the general systems and the basic structure of the Product. This is the first portion of the Standard Numbering System.

children.title: Subsystem Code (SSC) Column
children.content: The Subsystem Code (SSC) is the subsystem portion of the second element of the Standard Numbering System and describes the further breakdown of the system.

children.title: Sub-SubSystem Code (SSSC) Column
children.content: The Sub-SubSystem Code (SSSC) is the sub-subsystem portion of the second element of the Standard Numbering System and describes the further breakdown of the system.

children.title: Assy Code (AC) Column
children.content: The Assy Code (AC) is the third element of the Standard Numbering System. It provides identification for units in complex systems.

children.title: Disassembly Code (DC) Column
children.content: The Disassembly Code (DC) provides the breakdown condition of an assembly to which maintenance information applies.

children.title: Disassembly Code Variant (DCV) Column
children.content: The Disassembly Code Variant (DCV) designates alternative items of equipment or components differing slightly in design but not enough to warrant a change of the system difference code.

children.title: Information Code (IC) Column
children.content: The Information Code (IC) identifies the type of information within a data module.

children.title: Information Code Variant (ICV) Column
children.content: The Information Code Variant (ICV) refines the Information Code to be more specific.

children.title: Item Location Code (ILC) Column
children.content: The Item Location Code (ILC) identifies where the maintenance task will be performed in relation to the equipment/system.

children.title: Learn Code (LCN) Column
children.content: The Learn Code (LCN) describes the type of human performance technology or training information that is in the content of the data module.

children.title: Learn Event Code (LEC) Column
children.content: The Learn Event Code (LEC) identifies which branch of the learn Schema is being used.

children.title: Techname Column
children.content: The Techname identifies the nomenclature of the hardware or function.

children.title: Infoname Column
children.content: The Infoname contains the short description of the information code.

children.title: Type Column
children.content: The Type indicates the data module type to NAVSEA's Common Source Database. This column shall be populated with selections from Table 1. Before using a schema, check the NAVSEA S1000D Tagging and Authoring Guide to ensure that it is supported. The Tagging and Authoring Guidelines can be obtained from https://www.navsea.navy.mil/Home/Warfare-Centers/NSWC-Carderock/Resources/Technical-Information-Systems/Navy-XML-SGML-Repository/DTDs-Schemas/NAVSEA-S1000D-Tools-Repository/.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirement
preparation_instructions.content: The Data Management Requirement List shall be presented in an electronic file ASCII, comma-delimited file.
